title: Power of Explanations: Towards automatic debiasing in hate speech detection

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing feature attribution scores (via the Sampling and Occlusion explanation method) and False Positive Proportion (FPP) of religious identifier tokens (e.g., 'muslim', 'jew', 'islam') to determine if they improperly drive false positive predictions in hate speech classification.

Analyzing feature attribution scores and False Positive Proportion (FPP) of racial and ethnic identifier tokens (e.g., 'black', 'white', 'african', 'mexican') to detect unintended model sensitivity in hate speech classification.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the False Positive Proportion (FPP) and expected feature attribution impacts of tokens related to sexual orientation and gender identity (e.g., 'gay', 'lesbian', 'transgender', 'homosexual') in hate speech misclassifications.

Evaluating the False Positive Proportion (FPP) and feature attribution of political identifier tokens (e.g., 'democrat', 'liberal', 'leftist', 'communist') extracted during the training phase of hate speech classifiers.

Tracking the False Positive Proportion (FPP) and feature attribution of terms related to nationality and migration status (e.g., 'immigrant', 'migrants') to automatically detect group identifier misuse.
